title: Orthros: Phase-Aware Heterogeneous Attention for Efficient Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.13735v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Efficient attention mechanisms, such as linear and sliding window attention, aim to reduce the computational complexity of Transformers from quadratic to linear. However, their degraded in-context recall often necessitates interleaving full attention layers, leaving the quadratic bottleneck unresolved in long-context processing. To address this, we introduce Orthros attention, which shifts the efficiency paradigm from structural allocation to phase-aware decoupling. As a unified module, it dynamically switches its computation pattern across different phases of sequence processing, enabling linear complexity prefilling and full attention decoding. Our design grants Orthros attention a lower asymptotic complexity compared to vanilla Transformers in prevalent long-context scenarios characterized by heavy prefilling and light decoding. translated_title: Orthros：面向高效Transformer的相位感知异构注意力
translated_abstract: 诸如线性注意力和滑窗注意力等高效注意力机制，旨在将Transformer的计算复杂度从二次方降至线性。然而，这些机制在上下文记忆能力上的退化往往需要交错插入完整的注意力层，导致长文本处理中的二次方瓶颈依然未得到解决。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Orthros注意力，它将效率范式从结构性分配转变为相位感知解耦。作为一个统一模块，它能够在序列处理的不同阶段动态切换计算模式，实现线性复杂度的预填充和完整注意力的解码。我们的设计使Orthros注意力在以“重预填充、轻解码”为特征的常见长文本场景中，相比原始Transformer具有更低的渐近复杂度。除了理论推导和复杂度分析之外，大量实证评估也证明了Orthros的有效性……
tldr: Orthros注意力通过相位感知的方式在序列处理的不同阶段动态切换计算模式，实现了线性复杂度的预填充与完整注意力的解码相结合，从而在重预填充、轻解码的长文本场景下比原始Transformer具有更低的渐近复杂度。
